fact_review.title: An open letter to Dario: if you mean it, open the weights!
fact_review.summary: Dear Dario, You published We Must Pace the Frontier today, which committed Anthropic to embedded third-party evaluators and asked governments to require every other frontier company to match. Sam Altman agreed within hours.1 The stated goal is to slow down the pace of AI progress. I believe you’re being sincere, so I’m asking you to call for a different law, one that would actually slow things down, even though it would require real sacrifice on your part.
fact_review.manual_review_note: 공식 프로젝트·1차 출처가 연결되지 않은 항목입니다. 숫자, 규제, 회사 관계, 인과관계 주장은 원문을 열어 직접 확인하세요.
